villagerenhanced.dialogue.subtitle: %s · Level %s
villagerenhanced.dialogue.option.rumours: What do the others say about me?
villagerenhanced.dialogue.topics.body: What would you like to know?
villagerenhanced.dialogue.rumours.none: Nobody around here has much to say about you yet.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.rumours.honour: %s speaks of you with real warmth.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.rumours.acquai: %s says you've dealt fairly with them.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.rumours.revile: %s says you're not to be trusted.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.no_trades: They have nothing to trade right now.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.no_gift: They wouldn't want that. Try food, or something they buy.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.no_name: They don't care to introduce themselves to you.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.no_rumours: They don't know you well enough to talk about the neighbours. Trade with them a few times.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.no_belongings: They'd have to trust you a good deal more before showing you that.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.none: Nothing, at the moment. I've not found my trade yet.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.nitwit: Me? Oh, I keep busy. Very busy. Mostly with the standing.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.armorer: I work the forge — helmets, chestplates, whatever will turn a blade.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.butcher: I handle the meat. Salted, smoked, or fresh if you're quick.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.cartograp: I draw maps. Give me time and I'll chart places you've never walked.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.cleric: I tend to matters of the spirit. And a few stranger things besides.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.farmer: I work the fields. Wheat, mostly, and whatever else takes to the soil.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.fisherman: I fish. Early mornings, cold water, and the occasional surprise.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.fletcher: Arrows and bows. Steady hands and straight shafts, that's the whole trade.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.leatherwo: Hides and leather. Everything you'd want between you and the weather.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.librarian: Books, mostly. Someone has to remember things around here.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.mason: Stone. Cut it, shape it, stack it. It outlasts all of us.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.shepherd: Sheep and wool. Quiet work, and I prefer it that way.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.toolsmith: Tools. Pickaxes, axes, shovels — the things that actually get used.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.weaponsmi: Weapons. I'd rather you never needed one, but here we are.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.unknown: This and that. Hard to explain, really.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.improving: I'm still learning the trade — level %s. There's better work in me yet.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.work.mastered: And I've mastered it. You'll not find better hereabouts.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.belongings.int: Let's see what I've got on me...
villagerenhanced.dialogue.belongings.emp: Nothing at all, just now. My pockets are empty.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.busy: They're busy talking to someone else.
villagerenhanced.dialogue.closed.too_far: You walked away from the conversation.
